_note: Five $100 paper accounts, each mirroring one Polymarket wallet. Picked 2026-11-19 from rivo.markets (all-time Polymarket leaderboard, stats as shown that day) and checked against each wallet's last 200 Polymarket trades. None carries rivo's MARKET MAKER badge; all traded in the past day.

accounts.name: BreakTheBank
accounts.why: Polymarket's #1 sports wallet by profit this month. Huge bets (median fill ~$16.7k) at coin-flip prices and many fills per game, so its edge is thin per trade and results swing.

accounts.name: Flipadelphia
accounts.why: US football specialist, the sports Kalshi lists best. Mostly buys (90%), ~$1.5k median fill, 84 events in 18 days.

accounts.name: ic4cream
accounts.focus: Multi-sport: college football and basketball, tennis, esports
accounts.why: The most copyable wallet found: 97% of bets placed more than 15 min before the game (median 7 hours), ~24 bets a day at coin-flip prices, ~$440 median.

accounts.name: GetsOnBase
accounts.why: Highest copy score among active pre-game bettors (94% pre-game). Only ~10 bets a week, so results take longer to mean anything.

accounts.name: dabossrealman
accounts.why: Kept as a control. Bets only during games (median 2 hours after tip-off): +$751 in a 30-day backtest at its own prices, −$76 when copied 15 minutes later. Shows live whether in-game edges survive copying.
